notes: Canonical joint/movement vocabulary for muscle_actions v2. A superset of what exercise definitions can currently use (see the authoring schema); the extra actions let the table describe muscles correctly, e.g. posterior deltoid horizontal abduction. Existing names are kept unchanged for compatibility.

stabilization_demands.ankle_stability: Controls the ankle/subtalar joint under load in stance.
stabilization_demands.anterior_shoulder_stability: Resists anterior translation of the humeral head.
stabilization_demands.anti_extension_hip: Resists the hip being pulled into extension.
stabilization_demands.anti_extension_spine: Resists lumbar extension (e.g. plank, overhead press).
stabilization_demands.anti_flexion_spine: Resists lumbar flexion under load (e.g. squat, deadlift).
stabilization_demands.anti_rotation_torso: Resists trunk rotation (e.g. one-arm press, carry).
stabilization_demands.elbow_joint_integrity: Compresses and protects the elbow joint under load.
stabilization_demands.elbow_stability: Holds the elbow position when it is not the moving joint.
stabilization_demands.femoral_head_stabilization: Centres the femoral head in the acetabulum.
stabilization_demands.glenohumeral_stabilization: Centres the humeral head in the glenoid (rotator cuff role).
stabilization_demands.grip: Sustained finger and thumb flexion to hold a bar, handle, dumbbell or body weight (finger flexors, thumb flexors and intrinsic hand muscles).
stabilization_demands.humeral_head_stabilization: Depresses/centres the humeral head during arm elevation.
stabilization_demands.intra_abdominal_pressure: Deliberate bracing that raises intra-abdominal pressure under heavy load: transversus abdominis, obliques, rectus abdominis, diaphragm and pelvic floor.
stabilization_demands.knee_joint_stability: Controls knee valgus/varus and rotation under load.
stabilization_demands.patellar_tracking: Guides the patella in its groove.
stabilization_demands.pelvic_alignment: Holds pelvic tilt in the sagittal plane.
stabilization_demands.pelvic_leveling_frontal: Keeps the pelvis level in single-leg stance.
stabilization_demands.postural_stabilization: Antigravity holding of an upright posture: trunk extensors and deep trunk stabilizers (multifidus, transversus abdominis, internal oblique), hip and lower-limb extensors. Never facial, ocular, laryngeal, lingual, palatal, upper-limb or hand/foot intrinsic muscles.
stabilization_demands.postural_sway_control: Ankle/hip strategy that controls standing sway.
stabilization_demands.scapular_anchoring: Fixes the scapula to the thorax as a base for arm force.
stabilization_demands.scapular_retraction_stability: Holds the scapula retracted under load.
stabilization_demands.scapular_stabilization: General scapular control during arm movement.
stabilization_demands.shoulder_position_hold: Holds the upper arm still while a load acts on it from further down the limb, e.g. upper arms kept beside the torso in a curl or overhead during a triceps extension (isometric deltoid and shoulder flexor/extensor work). Distinct from glenohumeral_stabilization, which centres the humeral head.
stabilization_demands.wrist_stability: Holds the wrist neutral against a load in the hand (wrist flexors and extensors co-contracting).

weight_rubric.1.0: Prime mover: the main muscle for this action.
weight_rubric.0.7-0.9: Major contributor alongside the prime mover.
weight_rubric.omit: No meaningful contribution; do not list the action.
